scope_classes.subscription_setup: Role assignment and provider discovery remain subscription-scoped.
scope_classes.resource_group_candidate: Selected service lifecycle actions target the deployment resource group after provider validation.
scope_classes.data_plane: Cosmos, Blob, and Digital Twins data actions are separate from ARM management actions.
scope_classes.entra_external: Microsoft Graph/Entra application operations are bootstrap or preflight responsibilities, not ARM custom-role actions.

accepted_gaps: Service-family wildcards are explicit PoC inputs and not a formal least-privilege proof.
The subscription/resource-group split and Graph grants need supervised provider validation.
No billing, tenant creation, or subscription creation authority is retained.
activation_gates: current provider operations contain every frozen action pattern
required resource providers are registered or a typed manual prerequisite is returned
supervised deploy/destroy smoke records no missing action
